component.name: MT Nordic Blue GTK3 theme
component.summary: Modular GNOME theme for GTK3 Flatpak apps (Dark and Light)

description.p: GTK3 theme extension so sandboxed Flatpak apps follow the MT Nordic Blue and MT Nordic Light desktop theme. Installed automatically when the host GTK theme is set to MT-Nordic-Blue.

Adds MT Nordic Light (Glacial Snow Storm) variant, 4K 3D Glacial Silk Bloom wallpaper suite with inverted high-contrast adaptive pairing, dedicated Shell light theme, and refined notification cards with MPRIS media playback controls.
Initial release of MT Nordic Blue suite.
